items.text: Greetings, Brinehunters!
We just applied a new hotfix to Abyssus, intended to solve some of the bugs reported since the launch of Patch 1.3 - Brinerot.
Please keep in mind that in order to apply the fix, Abyssus must be closed and restarted. Moreover, you won’t be able to join the sessions of players who have not downloaded it yet.
Fixed a bug for which Plague could infinitely stack when repeatedly equipping it.
Fixed a bug for which Padded Suit could infinitely stack when repeatedly equipping it.
Fixed a bug for which The Golemancer remained invulnerable when damaged with Retaliating Barrier.
Fixed a bug that made the Engine Rifle’s Binary Cooling upgrade not work for some players.
Fixed a bug that made Hastened Dash stop working after returning to lobby.
Fixed a bug that reduced maximum Syringe capacity to 1 for some players
Fixed a bug that made a player’s controller vibrate when other players performed an action
Fixed a bug that made Foreground Max Framerate settings revert after putting the game out of focus (alt-tabbing).
Fixed a bug that made Ancient Spear pass through surfaces.
Fixed a bug for which the Seekers progress indicator did not show above certain enemies and objectives.
Fixed a bug for which the challenge Disc Thrower Connoisseur could be unlocked before unlocking Dr. Discstein.
Fixed a bug for which Golden Pocket upgrades would not increase the merchant’s discount correctly.

Greeting Brinehunters!

We just applied a new hotfix to Abyssus to address some of the issues reported in the first week of Content Update 1.3 and to implement the Soul Wheel changes, the Lobby Codes feature, and the console QoL elements you requested.
We are still working on your feedback and will roll out further fixes as we investigate and address the issues you report.
Please keep in mind that in order to apply the fix, Abyssus must be closed and restarted. Moreover, you won’t be able to join sessions with players who haven't downloaded it yet.
Lobby Codes: Players are now able to see their lobby's unique code, and share it with friends to play together cross-platform through the "Join with Room Code" button in the Session Browser.
All the slots in the Soul Wheel can now be filled (provided you have enough Soul Fragments to spend), and the three top abilities are no longer mutually exclusive
You can now scroll through the Lobby Browser menu while using a controller
Fixed an instance in which attacks damaged all the players, even when only one player was hit
Fixed an instance in which single-target attacks targeted all the players incorrectly
Fixed a bug for which Raging Storm was not scaling with all separate windburst radius increments
Fixed a bug for which the enemy line of sight was not working as intended
Fixed a chest clipping into the wall in the Submarine
Fixed a bug for which Enduring Flames was not updating its duration properly
Fixed a crash occurring when too many lightning instances were triggered
(PS5) Fixed a crash happening during enemies' spawn
Fixed an issue in Backup Battery, causing a stack overflow crash

Brinehunter friends,

We would like to share with you some news about our upcoming free update. One of the most requested new types of content has been playable areas with new enemies and bosses, so we are happy to announce that it’s exactly what is coming this summer in 1.3!
The new playable area will be all about massive, brinepunk machinery. It is very art-heavy, keeping our artists quite busy.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122578/127c210bf2a3c48ae24e784b88e2545c1f160d05.png"]

But we also wanted our programmers to improve other parts of the game: one code-heavy feature we are working on is porting the game to Xbox and PlayStation 5 with full cross-platform multiplayer. This means you’ll be able to group up with PC & console players alike, which will lead to a lot more open lobbies available to jump straight into the action.
Here is a rundown of all the new content coming to Abyssus in patch 1.3:
A new playable area!
Full of new enemies, of course. Hulking, reanimated humanoid brine-monsters.
With a new elite encounter…
…And a new boss encounter!
Also, a new God. The Brine God, with 15 new blessings, joins the fray!
And we’re adding 5 new blessings for each existing God.
We also revamped the skill tree, with new skills to pick.
On top of that, a streamlined matchmaking system & quickplay option
Xbox and PlayStation versions with full cross-platform multiplayer
And last, but certainly not least, new sea shanties!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122578/da2a78c87c33213d8dad5afa4bb048b4f803d678.png"]

This will be our biggest update yet! No precise date for the patch has been set so far, because there’s a lot of QA involved in making the new playable area run as smoothly as possible, but we will let you know as soon as we can.

And as always, patch 1.3 will be completely free. It will also contain a lot of goo, that is, brine gone bad. Therefore, we’ll accompany the content patch with a new cosmetic DLC called Brinerot Pack for those who want to support our work and look snazzy even while knee-deep in goo.
We hope you’ll enjoy the goo as much as you’ll enjoy shooting the horrendous brine-monsters wallowing in it!
The DoubleMoose Team

Greetings Brinehunters!

Today, our expedition reaches a new milestone! Patch 1.2 is out, bringing a new weapon, a new skill, new boss patterns, new challenges and cosmetic rewards, and an avalanche of balance improvements, bug fixes, and QOL updates. Take a look at the official Feature Trailer for a taste of what's waiting for you under the depths.

Patch 1.2 is but a step on our triumphal march to conquer the Abyss: soon we will disclose more information about the upcoming patch 1.3, which will be the biggest one yet. But without further ado, let's take a look at the brinefrosted bounty you'll get in this patch - for free, as always:

The favorite weapon of the Northern Reaches' hunters, now powered by brine. Trading fire rate for uncanny precision, each harpoon shot through primary fire will increase your combo point gauge, allowing you to unleash a secondary shot that will grow in power according to the amount of combo points spent. The perfect weapon for the Brinehunters who want a gun that packs a punch at any range, without sacrificing crowd control capabilities.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122578/4b42bbeef72debd068fdff2334dca0fa5d48b58c.gif"]

Imbued with the energies of the Surge, the Smiting Spear is a pointed stick that sticks to the point: it will attach to whatever it is thrown against, be it an enemy or the environment, and deal continuous damage around itself. Ideal for zone denial, disrupting large crowds of enemies, and giving To'raka some of his own medicine.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122578/eaadb663b6b2eb48ecc73e4a5d0ea93514f83e99.png"]

Forget your muscle memory and challenge the new incarnations of the Golemancer, Kri'Su, and Un'glu - now empowered by the powers of the Surge! Test your skills against their all-new attacks and unexpected abilities. There is no comfort zone in the depths below...
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41122578/f4aedfb7c059e778579cdc3a7a9f7d94c8bd2cb4.png"]

New content means new challenges, and with new challenges come new rewards! Face the danger of the depths with the brand-new gear implemented in 1.2, and you’ll be able to unlock warm clothes and festive cheer for the frozen season. And if frozen is precisely what you’re looking for, you can support us by buying the new Brinefrost DLC! As usual, this is a cosmetic-only pack; made to support our work on the following content patches, which will bring even more free game content!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4168330/Abyssus__Brinefrost_Pack/"]

Yes! We are already hard at work on patch 1.3, the biggest one yet, which will bring even more content to Abyssus, including a whole new area and its deadly inhabitants. Stay tuned on the Official Abyssus Discord for the latest news and to let us know your feedback on patch 1.2!
Your support is incredibly appreciated and helps us make Abyssus better with each patch. Speaking of which, you can check below the full...
A new weapon that can be unlocked.
Complete New Challenges for additional mods.
New mods for the harpoon gun in the Ancient Forge.
A new ability that can be unlocked.
New mods in the Ancient Forge.
New challenge to unlock extra mods in the Ancient forge for the Harpoon

Numbers now truncate and add symbols when reaching above 10,000 damage.

Blessing Upgrades, Healing Syringes, and Keys are now melee-able for Gold.

Fixed an issue where some rooms could clip into others.

Increased the base damage and damage scaling.
Increased the chance to spawn Tentacles with unupgraded Primary/Secondary.

Increased the duration of the Vitamins buff.
Increased the range of the check that counts how many Allies there are.
Increased the duration of the Acid status effect
Increased the chance to throw several objects with the Minor and Major Blessings.

Increased the amount of Gold required at higher ranks of Pot of Gold.
Wishing Wells can no longer give out multiple copies of the same item.
Increased the chance of gaining a reward from 50% to 60%.

Quadruple Kill is now a Triple Kill challenge.
Battery now only requires 100 hits.
Eco Warfare now only requires 10 kills.
Deadline now only requires 3 kills.
Boom! now only requires 3 kills.
Shot, Chaser! now only requires 3 kills.

Sharpshooter now only requires 500 damage.
High Noon now only requires 5 kills.
Fixed Domino only dealing damage when you kill an enemy with the Grenade.
Fixed Pressure Arrow not applying blessings from Primary/Secondary Fire correctly.
Fixed Plasma Launcher mod 'Bouncy Core' not incrementally applying its effect.
Fast Trigger now properly resets the damage when the time between Brine Revolver shots is too long.
Fixed an issue where certain Blessing Passives scaled with the wrong value, causing them to scale either faster or slower than intended.

Added a cap to the player's incoming damage multiplier to prevent them from becoming invulnerable by stacking defensive blessings.

Fixed instances of bosses showing the wrong enemy name in the player’s death screen.

Fixed Un'glu spawning the "teleport crystal" mid phase.
Fixed Sharpshooter and Charge Scope only taking base Revolver damage into account.
Fixed setup where player was able to cheese encounters by spawning turrets just before pressing the unstuck button.
Fixed a few cases where clients applied rate-of-fire changes twice, causing desynced animations/FX.
Fixed difficulties not applying ranks correctly in other languages.
Fixed Choice B at Corrupted Depths giving Choice A rewards.

Fixed Corrupted Depths giving a different reward category than the ones you can choose from.

Fixed Bottomless Chasm giving a corrupted depth node without letting you choose.

Fixed Primal Bruiser being able to hook players just after dying.

Ho there, Brinehunters!

We wanted to let you know that we’ve got a hotfix plunging down towards the Abyss as we speak - bringing some needed balancing and bug fixes to the Abyssus 1.1 release. We once again thank you for your incredible support, and for all of the feedback you’ve been sending in.
We’ve four main elements for this hotfix, to help you navigate your way through the Briney depths:
Fixed a crash related to Enemy navigation
Added an “I’m Stuck” button to help you get out of places a Brinehunter should never have gotten into (though this won’t be available during Boss fights)
Fixed a potential softlock where Brinehunters could encounter rooms which don’t recognise completion
Fixed a bug where players’ maximum speed was capped incorrectly (it is now capped at 300% and not the previous 2,500%)

We continue to monitor gameplay closely and will continue to fine tune the darkest depths based on your feedback. Please do head down to the briney depths and let us know how these balances feel, and send a telegram with your thoughts via Discord or our social media spaces.
The quest for Brine and Glory continues!
Drop your thoughts on our Discord or community channels.
— The DoubleMoose Team

Greetings, Brinehunters!
This patch brings new gameplay modes, quality-of-life improvements, and a long list of bug fixes and balance changes, all completely free for all players.
We believe in fair content access. That’s why this patch and every future gameplay update in Abyssus will always be free, forever.
We also dropped a brand-new cosmetic pack to support ongoing development. See details below

notes.title: New modes for the expeditions are available

items.text: Infinite mode lets you continue looping before facing the final boss.
Random order mode introduces a new challenge where areas appear in a random order.
These can be accessed after completing a full run, and are found in the Deep Water Tank.
Added 4 new challenges and cosmetics relating to the new modes.
Added and improved Animation, VFX and SFX in many areas of the game.
Added and improved general danger indicators in the game.
Rerolling Blessings of the Ancient Forge now costs more per reroll, capping the cost at 4 Soul Fragments.
Optimized usage of pre-load tables to decrease stutter during gameplay.
Added a better overview of the player's equipment in the expedition end screen.
More Blessings can now be upgraded with the addition of infinite mode.
Blessings can now be upgraded to +10 rather than only once.
Increased readability of the multiplayer frames.
Added a setting to swap crosshair color.
Only 30 Brine Canisters are now needed to access the Infinite difficulty scaling, meaning that you can leave out some of the difficulties you donʼt like while still accessing infinite scaling.
Updated various descriptions.
Changed balance of defender god to prevent players becoming invincible.
Gardens Elite: Elite Berserker
Shockwave travels slower and has increased visibility.
Added line ground indicators when aiming charge attack towards players.
Sanctuary Elite: Elite Catalyst
Increased rotation speed & time between shooting ranged attacks.
Re-worked the spinning beam attack to be easier to jump over and adjusted its timings.
Sanctuary Boss: Highpriest Unʼglu
Decreased the health of Un'glu Necromancers.
Decreased the speed at which Un'Glu's Surge Zones grow with Abyssal Leviathan.
During Un'glu boss fight with Abyssal Leviathans enabled, surge zones now scale down to a minimum value rather than remove themselves when destroyed.
During the Un'glu boss fight with Abyssal Leviathans enabled, surge zones now scale down slower after being destroyed.
Fixed issue with Un'glu growing surge crystal health scaling
Anchor

Reduced duration and tick rate of brine upgrade, increased damage & slow amount to compensate.
Decreased 'Bulwark' invincibility duration from 1 second to 0.4 seconds.
Grenade
Decreased duration & tick rate of shrapnel & gas grenade upgrades, increased damage per tick to offset.
Decreased the slowing effect and duration of Lethargic.
Fixed various crashes.

Fixed collision issues in several levels to avoid the player getting stuck in the environment.
Fixed an issue where some chests were stuck within walls.

items.text: Looking sharp never hurt anyone (except the enemies you crush).

Drop us your thoughts on the new modes, the balance tweaks, or your wildest Infinite Mode runs!
The DoubleMoose Team
Greetings, Brinehunters!
A new hotfix has been deployed to address some issues you reported in your launch feedback. Here's what it fixes:
The "Agnostic" challenge should now complete correctly
The "Monarch" challenge should now complete correctly
The waves on the Second Herald should now despawn as intended when the boss is defeated

And that's it (for now)!We're still working hard on the game to refine what's currently live and to prepare the new content drops, and we want to thank you for the feedback you keep sending our way. We're making Abyssus better for you, and thanks to you .

Greetings, Brinehunters!
We just applied a new hotfix to Abyssus, intended to solve some of the issues reported since the launch of the game.
We are still working on your feedback, and we will roll out further fixes as we investigate and take action on the different issues you report.
Please keep in mind that in order to apply the fix, Abyssus must be closed and restarted. Moreover, you won’t be able to join the sessions of players who have not downloaded it yet.
Optimized Gauge should now correctly increase shotgun damage after a Boss has been frozen or slowed.
After rejoining a lobby, some of the animated objectives no longer appear frozen.
Players should no longer get stuck in the Diving Bell after defeating Secret Phase To'raka.
Fixed a crash happening when equipping a loadout without getting a savegame.
Fixed a crash happening when accepting session invites without a valid unique NetID
Dying during the Secret Phase To'raka countdown should no longer cause visual issues.
The Diving Bell no longer appears during To'raka's second phase.
The “Weapon Mastery” challenge should now be completed as intended.
The “Speedster” challenge can now be completed correctly
The “Collector” challenge should now work as intended and should be retroactively awarded to players who completed all weapons and abilities.
The “Turret Mastery” and “Unstable Cores” challenges should now work as intended.
The “No Need” challenge should now also work with syringes not obtained during the run.
Spark Orbs should now have the right color in multiplayer.
The Plasma Launcher projectiles’ color is now consistent with primary/secondary fire.
The New Monarch challenge should now give the correct notification once unlocked.
Stable String stacks no longer reset when an enemy dies.
Players should no longer take damage when entering a new zone.
Enemies should no longer get stuck in walls.
Players should no longer trigger an infinite loading screen on ALT-TAB.
It is now possible to switch tabs with RB and LB after changing languages.
Players should no longer get stuck in the Workbench by dashing into it as it's opening.
The hole in the Royal Gardens’ Flooded Hamlet should now be easier to get out of.
Players should no longer be able to die after defeating Secret Phase To'raka.
Diver Suit's left arm no longer appears deformed on the camera.
The indicator for when Automatic Action and Trigger mutators are active should now appear correctly.
The Unstable Core mod should now stun enemies as intended.
Execute now counts as a melee attack for the “Unbeatable” challenge
Explosive Culling mod should now increase damage based on missing enemy health as intended.
Power from Pain buff should now update correctly.
Accelerating Core should no longer increase range when shooting in quick succession.
Players can now move right when viewing Expeditions with a controller.
Players should now be able to view profiles and access all the relevant options when playing on a controller.
Players should no longer get stuck in the Helmet selection in the Wardrobe when using a controller.
Various crash fixes
Increased the damage on the Shotgun primary fire
The health of To'raka’s invulnerability spheres has been reduced.
The health of Unglu’s Surgezones and Crystals has been reduced.
Increased the timer before the “sudden death” in To’raka’s secret phase and slightly lowered Toraka’s health during this phase.
The speed of the Elite Berserker has been reduced.
RichGetRicher - Reduced chance from 15->10 %
Slightly increased the timeframe to beat the Combat Bow challenge
Greetings, Brinehunters! As your feedback flows in, we are hard at work on your reports to make the Abyssus experience as smooth and polished as it can be.
We are currently testing a new hotfix that we'll deploy next week. This latest update will fix some of the issues you reported, and notably:
Progression blockers and “stuck” scenarios
notably during the To’raka fight, the Workbench, or in environmental hazards.
Visual and animation glitches (frozen objectives, incorrect projectile or orb colors, deformed models, missing indicators).
Weapon and mod functionalities that are not working as intended.
Controller navigation and menu accessibility.

Boss and encounters balancing.: We'll publish more details with the full changelog early next week. In the meantime, we want to reiterate our thanks for your feedback, for enjoying Abyssus, and for helping us make it better day after day!
The DoubleMoose Team

releases.displayName: UPDATE ON THE SESSION BROWSER ISSUE

items.text: We have been looking to solve the current issue causing the game to crash when the Session Browser is accessed in-game, and we have deployed a hotfix that should solve the problem.
Please remember that you will have to close and restart Abyssus to download this hotfix.

You will still be able to play in solo and with your friends through Steam invites, as it is currently possible, and the Session Browser should no longer crash the game. If you still experience issues with this or any other of the game features, do not hesitate to send us your feedback!
We are sorry for the inconvenience and thank all of you for your support.
The DoubleMoose Team
